source.title: eBird Taxonomy reference API · Cornell Lab of Ornithology
source.scope: Selected factual species identifiers and short names, solely to create outbound reference links. Full taxonomy, observations, range text, photographs and recordings are not redistributed. No open license is asserted for the publisher’s complete checklist.
source.citation: eBird / Cornell Lab of Ornithology. eBird Taxonomy reference API, species-only snapshot retrieved 18 November 2026.

meta.limits: Outbound reading references only, not equivalent taxon concepts. Exact common-name candidates are labelled separately. No fuzzy names, guessed species codes, or automatic taxonomy changes. Unmatched names open eBird Explore for manual lookup.
